title: Quick Dementia Test
summary: A quick challenge for recall, attention, language and reasoning.

landing.intro: Think your memory is still sharp? These 10 quick questions test recall, attention and reasoning - and the delayed questions are harder than they look.

about.body:
This ten-question brain challenge mixes immediate and delayed recall with attention, language, visual memory and simple reasoning. It is designed as an engaging snapshot of performance today, not as a dementia screening tool.

Performance can change with sleep, stress, mood, medication, language, education, eyesight, hearing, device use and simple chance. A score from an online quiz cannot confirm or rule out dementia.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Study each memory cue carefully when it appears.
Choose one answer for every question without outside help.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: This quiz is for entertainment and general learning only. It is not a validated cognitive assessment and cannot diagnose dementia or any other condition. If memory or thinking changes are new, worsening or affecting daily life, speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked and your brain-challenge score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: Exceptionally Sharp Today
profile-1.copy: You held onto the delayed details and stayed accurate across attention, language and reasoning. This is an excellent quiz result—not a medical finding.

profile-2.title: A Strong Snapshot
profile-2.copy: You cleared the challenge with strong recall and steady attention. One carefully placed detail may have stopped a near-perfect finish.

profile-3.title: A Mixed But Capable Round
profile-3.copy: Several thinking skills clicked, while a few memory or attention traps landed. A single quiz score cannot measure cognitive health.

profile-4.title: A Tougher Round Today
profile-4.copy: This mix of delayed recall and close-match choices proved difficult. Tiredness, distraction, language and familiarity can all affect a result.

profile-5.title: The Challenge Caught You Out
profile-5.copy: The quiz hid details between very different tasks, and several traps worked. This score cannot indicate dementia or replace a professional assessment.

score.disclaimer: This entertainment score cannot diagnose or rule out dementia. Seek qualified advice for persistent or worsening concerns.
